headline: Taiwan Mobile launches tender offer for Systex, capped at NT$29.1 billion; will hold majority after acquisition
summary: Taiwan Mobile will launch a public tender offer for IT services firm Systex, at about NT$184.5 per share, a premium of about 29%. The offer is capped at NT$29.1 billion and would give Taiwan Mobile a majority stake.
why: Taiwan Mobile is a major Taiwanese telecom operator, and Systex is the island's largest IT services company. Tender offers at a premium typically reprice the target's shares toward the offer price.
why_moved: The tender offer price of about NT$184.5 per share carries a premium of about 29%, which typically pulls the target's share price toward the offer level.
